ننفئي (form VII)
# نَنْفَئِي (nanfaʔī) /nan.fa.ʔiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَأَى (infaʔā)
# نَنْفَئِيَ (nanfaʔiya) /nan.fa.ʔi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَأَى (infaʔā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
